meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你发现并安装可用的技能扩展
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想为智能体添加新功能但不知道有哪些技能可用。
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install agent skills to extend capabilities.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add new features to your agent but don't know what skills are available.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你搜索、推荐并安装社区技能，扩展自身能力。它会先查排行榜，再运行搜索命令，验证质量后给出安装指引。
howto.when: 当你问“怎么做X”、“有没有做X的技能”或表示想扩展Claude的能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个写React测试的技能。
say.note: Claude会搜索相关技能并推荐。

say.text: 有没有能自动生成更新日志的技能？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you discover, recommend, and install community skills to extend its capabilities. It first checks the leaderboard, then runs search commands, verifies quality, and provides installation instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", or express interest in extending Claude's capabilities.

say_en.text: Find a skill for writing React tests.
say_en.note: Claude will search and recommend relevant skills.

say_en.text: Is there a skill to auto-generate changelogs?
say_en.note: Claude will look for changelog-related skills.
